title: Contrastive Learning Collapse:
prompt: **Contrastive Learning Collapse:** In self-supervised contrastive learning, what prevents the encoder from mapping every single input $x$ to the exact same constant vector $c$ to get zero loss? (Contrastive losses use negative pairs / uniformity on the hypersphere; non-contrastive methods like BYOL use a momentum teacher encoder + stop-gradient + predictor head).
